title: Item:Orb of the Efreet
wikitext:
This item is a quest item obtained at the end of [[Chains of Flame]] and turned in to [[Jaefan Druz]] to obtain the [[Orb of the Djinn]].
 
The [[Orb of the Djinn]] is then turned in to [[Zawabi the Elder Djinni]] to advance the Against the Demon Queen quest line.

The other 2 items to advance [[Against the Demon Queen]] quest line:
* [[Blessed Blood Offering]] Obtained from [[An Offering of Blood]] 
* [[Phylactery of Raiyum]] Obtained from [[The Chamber of Raiyum]]

After bringing all 3 items to [[Zawabi the Elder Djinni]], he will bestow you the pre-raid quest.
